questions.question: If the 6-digit number N29M11 is divisible by 11, then which of the options below can give a possible correct relation between M and N?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For divisibility by 11, the difference of the sums of alternate digits must be 0 or a multiple of 11.

Sum of odd position digits = N + 9 + 1 = N + 10

Sum of even position digits = 2 + M + 1 = M + 3

Difference = (N + 10) − (M + 3) = N − M + 7

Equating to 0 for a valid single-digit relation: N − M + 7 = 0 ⇒ M − N = 7.

**∴ The correct answer is M − N = 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The 6-digit number is N29M11, and it is perfectly divisible by 11.

**Concept Used:**

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of its digits at odd places and the sum of its digits at even places is either 0 or a multiple of 11.

**Calculations:**

⇒ The given number = N29M11

⇒ Sum of digits at odd places (from left to right) = N + 9 + 1 = N + 10

⇒ Sum of digits at even places (from left to right) = 2 + M + 1 = M + 3

⇒ Difference = (Sum of odd places) − (Sum of even places)

⇒ Difference = (N + 10) − (M + 3)

⇒ Difference = N − M + 7

⇒ For the number to be divisible by 11, this difference must be equal to 0, 11, or a multiple of 11.

⇒ Case 1: Equating difference to 0

⇒ N − M + 7 = 0

⇒ M − N = 7

⇒ Case 2: Equating difference to 11

⇒ N − M + 7 = 11

⇒ N − M = 4

⇒ Since M and N are single digits, both relations are mathematically possible, but only M − N = 7 is present among the given choices.

**∴ The correct answer is M − N = 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 3 and 9

A number is perfectly divisible by 3 or 9 if the sum of all its digits is divisible by 3 or 9, respectively.

Divisibility Rule of 4 and 8

A number is divisible by 4 if its last two digits form a number divisible by 4. It is divisible by 8 if its last three digits form a number divisible by 8.

Combined Divisibility Rule of 7, 11, and 13

If the difference between the number formed by the last three digits and the number formed by the remaining leading digits is divisible by 7, 11, or 13, then the original number is divisible by 7, 11, or 13 respectively.
</p

questions.question: A cylinder has its radius reduced by 20% while its height is increased by 40%. What is the percentage change in its volume?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the Ratio Method for successive changes (V ∝ r²h):

Radius ratio (20% decrease = −1/5) ⇒ 4/5

Height ratio (40% increase = +2/5) ⇒ 7/5

Volume ratio = (4/5)² × (7/5) = 16/25 × 7/5 = 112/125

Decrease = 125 − 112 = 13 parts ⇒ % Decrease = (13 ÷ 125) × 100 = 10.4%

**∴ The correct answer is 10.4% decrease.**

**Given:**

Radius of cylinder is reduced by 20%.

Height of cylinder is increased by 40%.

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cylinder = π × r² × h

**Calculations:**

⇒ Original Volume = π × (10)² × 10 = 1000π cubic units.

⇒ New radius = 10 − (20% of 10) = 8 units.

Volume Dependency in Cylinders

The volume of a cylinder changes in direct proportion to the square of its radius and linearly with its height (V ∝ r²h). Any change in the radius has a twofold compounded impact on the final volume.

Successive Percentage Formula

To calculate two continuous percentage changes x and y, use the formula: Net % change = x + y + (x × y) ÷ 100. This is useful for analyzing areas but must be applied twice for volumes involving r².

Multiplier/Ratio Logic

If values change to fraction 'a' and 'b' of their original, the new final value simply becomes (a² × b) of the initial state. This quickly bypasses complex intermediate decimal calculations.

questions.question: By availing two successive discounts of 20% and 10%, a customer got a discount of ₹23,800. Determine the marked price of the item.

Equivalent discount % for successive discounts of 20% and 10% = 20 + 10 − (20 × 10) ÷ 100 = 28%.

Given that 28% of the Marked Price = ₹23,800.

⇒ MP = (23,800 ÷ 28) × 100 = 850 × 100 = ₹85,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹85,000.**

Successive discounts = 20% and 10%

Total discount obtained = ₹23,800

**Formula Used:**

Effective Discount % = d₁ + d₂ − (d₁ × d₂) ÷ 100

Discount = Marked Price (MP) − Selling Price (SP)

questions.question: Mohan and Nishant start a business. Mohan invests ₹89,000 more than Nishant for 3 months and Nishant invests for 2 months. Mohan's share is ₹1,070 more than that of Nishant, out of a total profit of ₹4,280. Find the capital contributed by Mohan.

Capital Ratio = (P₁ ÷ T₁) : (P₂ ÷ T₂) = (5 ÷ 3) : (3 ÷ 2) = 10 : 9.

Difference in Capital Ratio = 10 − 9 = 1 unit → ₹89,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8,90,000.**

Use the (a − b)² algebraic identity to quickly evaluate squares near multiples of 100.

We can express 182 as (200 − 18).

Using (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²:

⇒ (200 − 18)² = 200² − 2 × 200 × 18 + 18²

⇒ 40000 − 7200 + 324 = 33124

**∴ The correct answer is 33124.**

Expression: 182²

(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

⇒ Here, a = 180 and b = 2

⇒ (180 + 2)² = 180² + 2 × 180 × 2 + 2²

⇒ 180² = 32400

⇒ 2 × 180 × 2 = 720

⇒ 2² = 4

⇒ Total sum = 32400 + 720 + 4

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total numbers to check: 393, 394, 395, 396, 397, 398, 399, 400, 401

⇒ Even numbers greater than 2 are not prime. Discard 394, 396, 398, 400.

⇒ Numbers ending in 5 are not prime. Discard 395.

⇒ For 401: √401 ≈ 20.02. Prime numbers ≤ 19 are 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19. 401 is not divisible by any of them. ∴ 401 is a prime number.

⇒ Total prime numbers between 393 and 401 = 2 (which are 397 and 401).

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

Prime Numbers

A prime number is a natural number greater than 1 that cannot be formed by multiplying two smaller natural numbers. It has exactly two distinct factors: 1 and itself.

Primality Test

Divisibility Rules

A number is divisible by 3 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 3. A number is divisible by 5 if its last digit is 0 or 5. A number is divisible by 2 if its last digit is 0, 2, 4, 6, or 8.

questions.question: The sum of the squares of two consecutive even natural numbers is 1460. The sum of the numbers is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the average of the two consecutive even numbers be a. The numbers will be (a − 1) and (a + 1).

Sum of their squares = (a − 1)² + (a + 1)² = 2(a² + 1)

⇒ 2(a² + 1) = 1460 ⇒ a² + 1 = 730 ⇒ a² = 729 ⇒ a = 27

The numbers are 26 and 28. Their sum is 26 + 28 = 54.

**∴ The correct answer is 54.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The sum of the squares of two consecutive even natural numbers is 1460.

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

**Calculation:**

Let the two consecutive even natural numbers be x and (x + 2).

According to the given condition:

⇒ x² + (x + 2)² = 1460

⇒ x² + x² + 4x + 4 = 1460

⇒ 2x² + 4x + 4 = 1460

⇒ 2x² + 4x − 1456 = 0

Dividing the entire equation by 2:

⇒ x² + 2x − 728 = 0

Factorising the quadratic equation:

⇒ x² + 28x − 26x − 728 = 0

⇒ x(x + 28) − 26(x + 28) = 0

⇒ (x − 26)(x + 28) = 0

⇒ x = 26 or x = −28

Since the numbers are natural numbers, x must be positive. Therefore, x = 26.

⇒ The second consecutive even number = x + 2 = 26 + 2 = 28.

⇒ Sum of the numbers = 26 + 28 = 54.

**∴ The correct answer is 54.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Consecutive Even and Odd Numbers

Consecutive even integers are always represented as 2n, 2n+2, 2n+4, etc. Consecutive odd integers are represented as 2n+1, 2n+3, 2n+5, etc.

Quadratic Formula

For a quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0, the exact roots can be found using the formula: x = (−b ± √(b² − 4ac)) ÷ 2a.

Sum and Product of Roots

For the general quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0, the sum of the roots is equal to −b/a and the product of the roots is equal to c/a.

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The unit digit of 861616843 is 3 (an odd number), which immediately eliminates even divisors like 36 and numbers ending in zero like 50.

Between 43 and 47, we can systematically split the given number into simple chunks: 86,00,00,000 + 16,16,800 + 43.

Each chunk is visibly divisible by 43 (86 ÷ 43 = 2 | 16168 ÷ 43 = 376 | 43 ÷ 43 = 1).

Since every single part perfectly divides by 43, the entire number is directly divisible by 43.

**∴ The correct answer is 43.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 861616843

Options provided = 43, 36, 50, 47

**Method Used:**

Basic divisibility rules and division by separating parts.

**Calculations:**

⇒ The given number 861616843 ends with the odd digit 3.

⇒ Any number ending with an odd digit cannot be completely divided by an even number.

⇒ Thus, the options 36 (even number) and 50 (ends with 0) are eliminated directly.

⇒ Now, check for divisibility by 43 by breaking the huge number into smaller, easily identifiable multiples.

⇒ 861616843 = 86,00,00,000 + 16,16,800 + 43

⇒ Part 1: 86,00,00,000 ÷ 43 = 2,00,00,000

⇒ Part 2: 16,16,800 ÷ 43 = (16168 × 100) ÷ 43 = 376 × 100 = 37600

⇒ Part 3: 43 ÷ 43 = 1

⇒ Since all individual parts yield an exact integer quotient without any remainder, the complete number is absolutely divisible by 43.

**∴ The correct answer is 43.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility by 2

A number is perfectly divisible by 2 only if its last digit is an even number (0, 2, 4, 6, or 8).

Divisibility by 10

A number is completely divisible by 10 (and its multiples like 50) strictly if its unit digit is 0.

Prime Number Divisibility Method

For larger primes like 43 or 47, breaking the large dividend into chunks that are easily recognizable multiples of the divisor is the quickest method to verify divisibility during an exam.
</p

questions.question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) if a sum of ₹400 is borrowed for 5.5 years at 16% per annum rate of interest.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective Rate % = Rate × Time

Effective Rate % = 16% × 5.5 = 88%

Simple Interest = Effective Rate % of Principal

⇒ SI = 88% of 400 = (88 ÷ 100) × 400 = 352

**∴ The correct answer is ₹352.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹400

Rate of Interest (R) = 16% per annum

Time (T) = 5.5 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

Amount in Simple Interest

The total amount (A) after a certain time is the sum of the Principal (P) and the Simple Interest (SI).
Formula: A = P + SI = P × [1 + (R × T) ÷ 100]

Compound Interest (CI)

Unlike Simple Interest, Compound Interest is calculated on the initial principal and the accumulated interest of previous periods.
Formula: A = P × [1 + (R ÷ 100)]T, and CI = A − P

Difference Between CI and SI

For 2 years, the difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest for the same principal and rate is given by:
Difference = P × (R ÷ 100)²

questions.question: Lokesh and Manoj can complete a certain piece of work in 11 and 15 days, respectively. They started to work together, and after 5 days, Manoj left. In how many days will Lokesh complete the remaining work?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(11, 15) = 165 units.

Lokesh's efficiency = 15 units/day, Manoj's efficiency = 11 units/day.

Work done together in 5 days = (15 + 11) × 5 = 130 units.

Remaining work = 165 − 130 = 35 units.

Time for Lokesh to finish remaining work = 35 ÷ 15 = 7/3 = 2¹/₃ days.

**∴ The correct answer is 2¹/₃ days.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Lokesh can complete the work in 11 days.

Manoj can complete the work in 15 days.

They work together for 5 days.

**Method Used:**

We use the LCM method to find the total work and individual efficiencies.

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**

 Manoj
 15
 11
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Combined efficiency of Lokesh and Manoj = 15 + 11 = 26 units/day

⇒ Work completed by both in 5 days = 26 × 5 = 130 units

⇒ Remaining work = Total work − Work completed

⇒ Remaining work = 165 − 130 = 35 units

⇒ Time taken by Lokesh to complete the remaining work = Remaining work ÷ Lokesh's efficiency

⇒ Time = 35 ÷ 15

⇒ Time = 7/3 = 2¹/₃ days

**∴ The correct answer is 2¹/₃ days.**

**__Additional Information__**

Total Work Concept

Total Work is assumed as the LCM of the days taken by individuals. Efficiency is the work done in one unit of time. (Total Work = Efficiency × Time).

Pipes & Cisterns

This is similar to time and work. An inlet pipe has positive efficiency while an outlet (leak) has negative efficiency.

Alternate Day Work

When individuals work on alternate days, calculate the work done in a complete cycle of 2 days and then determine the remaining work iteratively.

Work and Wages

Wages are always distributed in the ratio of the total work done by each person. If they work for the same duration, wages are distributed in the ratio of their efficiencies.
</p

questions.question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 11 hours, pipe B can fill the same tank in 26 hours and pipe C can fill the same tank in 12 hours. The time taken by them to fill the same tank if they operate together is::
questions.solution:

Total work = LCM(11, 26, 12) = 1716 units.

Efficiency of Pipe A = 1716 ÷ 11 = 156 units/hour.

Efficiency of Pipe B = 1716 ÷ 26 = 66 units/hour.

Efficiency of Pipe C = 1716 ÷ 12 = 143 units/hour.

Total efficiency = 156 + 66 + 143 = 365 units/hour.

Time taken = Total work ÷ Total efficiency = 1716 ÷ 365 = 4 ²⁵⁶/₃₆₅ hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 ²⁵⁶/₃₆₅ hours.**

Inlet vs Outlet Pipes

An inlet pipe fills the tank and its work is considered positive. An outlet pipe empties the tank and its work is considered negative.

Combined Efficiency Method

When multiple pipes operate together, their net rate of filling or emptying is the algebraic sum of their individual efficiencies: Net Efficiency = Σ(Inlet Efficiencies) − Σ(Outlet Efficiencies).

Work Capacity & Volume

If the flow rate (e.g., liters per minute) of a pipe is given, the total capacity of the tank can be found by multiplying the flow rate by the total time taken by that pipe to independently fill the tank.

questions.question: Yash travels 252 km at 63 km/hr, the next 891 km at 99 km/hr and the next 183 km at 61 km/hr. What is his average speed (in km/hr) for the whole journey? (Round off your answer to two decimal places)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Distance = 252 + 891 + 183 = 1326 km

Total Time = (252 ÷ 63) + (891 ÷ 99) + (183 ÷ 61) = 4 + 9 + 3 = 16 hours

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time = 1326 ÷ 16 = 82.875 km/hr

Rounding off 82.875 to two decimal places gives 82.88 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 82.88 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Average Speed for Equal Distances

If a person travels two equal distances at speeds S₁ and S₂, then Average Speed = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).

Relative Speed

Unit Conversion

questions.question: Himanshi bought a toy for Rs. 199, decorated it at a cost of Rs. 9, and sold the toy for Rs. 231. Find the loss or gain percentage.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total CP = Cost + Decoration = 199 + 9 = ₹208

Profit = Selling Price − Total CP = 231 − 208 = ₹23

Profit % = (Profit ÷ Total CP) × 100

Profit % = (23 ÷ 208) × 100 = 575/52%

**∴ The correct answer is 575/52% profit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost price of the toy = ₹199

Cost of decoration = ₹9

Selling price (SP) = ₹231

 
 Total CP = 208
 199 + 9 (decor)

 
 SP = 231
 
 
•

**Formula Used:**

Total CP = Original Cost Price + Overhead Charges

Profit = SP − Total CP

Profit % = (Profit ÷ Total CP) × 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total CP = 199 + 9 = ₹208

⇒ Since Selling Price > Total Cost Price, there is a profit.

⇒ Profit = 231 − 208 = ₹23

⇒ Profit % = (23 ÷ 208) × 100

⇒ Profit % = (23 ÷ 52) × 25

⇒ Profit % = 575/52%

**∴ The correct answer is 575/52% profit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Overhead Expenses

Any extra money spent on transportation, repairs, or decoration is always added to the base cost price to determine the actual effective cost price (Total CP) before calculating overall profit or loss.

Loss Percentage

When Total CP > SP, there is a loss instead of a profit. Loss = Total CP − SP, and the formula is: Loss % = (Loss ÷ Total CP) × 100.

Marked Price and Discount

A discount is universally calculated on the Marked Price (MP) of an item. The selling price after a discount can be found as: SP = MP × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100.
</p
